overview.tagline: Desktop-based technical SEO crawler for deep site audits
overview.description: Screaming Frog SEO Spider is a desktop-based website crawler that analyzes technical SEO issues. It crawls websites to identify broken links, redirects, duplicate content, configuration errors, and on-page SEO problems. It is the industry standard for technical SEO audits.

faqs.q: How much does Screaming Frog cost?
faqs.a: The SEO Spider license costs $279 per year per person (£199/€245). Bulk discounts: $265 for 5-9 seats, $249 for 10-19, $235 for 20+. A free version crawls up to 500 URLs.
Yes, the free version crawls up to 500 URLs per crawl. It finds broken links, redirects, and on-page issues but cannot render JavaScript or save crawls.

faqs.q: Can Screaming Frog crawl JavaScript sites?
faqs.a: Yes, the paid license includes JavaScript rendering. The free version does not support JavaScript rendering.

faqs.q: Is Screaming Frog better than Semrush Site Audit?
faqs.a: Screaming Frog is a deeper technical crawler with more configuration options. Semrush Site Audit is cloud-based and included with broader SEO features. Choose Screaming Frog for deep technical audits; choose Semrush for a full platform.

faqs.q: Does Screaming Frog have a monthly plan?
faqs.a: No, Screaming Frog is an annual subscription only. There is no monthly billing option.

faqs.q: Can I use Screaming Frog on multiple devices?
faqs.a: One license covers one person but can be installed on multiple devices owned by that person. Each team member needs their own license.
